# Security Policy

## Supported Versions

| Version | Supported |
|---|---|
| 0.1.x | ✅ |

## Reporting a Vulnerability

This package executes third-party code by design (skill scripts and CLI tools). We take the security model — trust levels, the install-time scanner, environment scrubbing and the integrity lockfile — seriously.

If you find a vulnerability, **do not open a public issue**. Instead, report it privately via [GitHub Security Advisories](https://github.com/andreagroferreira/laravel-ai-sdk-toolbox/security/advisories/new).

Please include:

- The affected version(s)
- A description of the vulnerability and its impact
- Steps to reproduce or a proof of concept

You can expect an acknowledgement within 72 hours and, if confirmed, a fix or mitigation plan as soon as reasonably possible. We will credit reporters in the release notes unless you prefer to remain anonymous.
